annotations.title: Start report runs in a batch

description: Starts a run of each of up to 50 reports of any type, as startReportRun does for one: each run updates its whole report, and a run of a report of another type than SlideDeck emails it when its email trigger is `all`. To update only some datasheets or syncs of a report, call startReportRun. Answers one result per report, each naming its id, with its run's id at once: follow each run with getReportRun. A report already running answers that run with started false, and a report you can't run fails on its own while the others still start. From an AI client, a batch of runs that emails any of the reports only asks the user to confirm it in Rollstack: it answers `confirmation-required` and runs once they confirm.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

ids.description: The reports to act on, of any `type`, by their `id` from `listReports`. From 1 to 50 ids; an id listed twice is acted on once.

repairSlides.description: Whether Rollstack repairs the slides with AI once the data is in: failed calculations, and text the new data made wrong. Pass `false` to read the data only, when you check and fix the slides yourself. If omitted, the slides are repaired. Only on reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck`.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.
